name: Prism Masjid
summary: A solid mosque volume turns in space, with a faceted dome, deep entrance, and substantial tower rising behind it.
why: Two contrasting architectural faces meet around a visible vertical seam. The dome follows the same angled volume, while a deep open doorway anchors the front face. An integrated minaret makes the composition a compact architectural object.
risk: The angled doorway and facets add complexity at 24 pixels. The unusual palette gives it a playful sculptural character rather than a traditional mosque identity.
key1: A mosque seen in three dimensions
reasonToChoose: You want the mosque to feel like a distinctive small architectural sculpture.
